name: Host-Slave Implementation with Interrupt-Driven Communication
definition: A parallel processing scheme where a host node handles I/O and data preparation (steps 1-2), and slave nodes handle computation (steps 3-4). It uses asynchronous, interrupt-driven communication to minimize idle time and overhead.
summary: This parallel volume rendering scheme uses an interrupt handler to overlap computation with data transfer, minimizing latency through exponential subcube reduction and early communication requests.
